channels.title: Chrome — desktop
channels.notes: Chrome desktop extension. Requires original enrolled native Device Bridge host.

channels.title: Edge — desktop
channels.notes: Edge extension. Requires the approved native Bridge host and published Edge ID.

channels.title: Firefox — desktop / supported Android
channels.notes: Desktop Firefox extension. Firefox Android add-ons cannot use this desktop nativeMessaging host; use the original Android companion for device connectivity.

channels.title: Safari — Apple
channels.notes: Apple macOS/iPhone/iPad Safari extension must be embedded and signed with the original qualified containing app.

channels.title: LeeWay Android companion
channels.notes: Android signed companion provides the original Device Bridge and Tablet display. Chrome for Android cannot run desktop Chrome Web Store extensions; mobile Edge/Firefox native Bridge extensions are not qualified.

channels.title: LeeWay Apple companion
channels.notes: Apple signed companion provides OS-native Bridge/Tablet; Safari browser integration requires the signed containing app. iOS Chrome/Edge/Firefox are not desktop extension hosts.

channels.title: LeeWay Windows Device Bridge
channels.notes: Original signed Windows Bridge installer; must register qualified Chrome/Edge/Firefox native-messaging hosts using official browser IDs after owner approval.

channels.title: LeeWay Linux Device Bridge
channels.notes: Original signed Linux Bridge installer/adapter; must register qualified native-messaging hosts with portable OS paths and device-scoped owner enrollment.
